sloka: भवनाद्भवनं गच्छ्न् ददर्श पवनात्मजः ।विविधाकृतिरूपाणि भवनानि ततस्ततः ॥५-४-९॥
transliteration: bhavanādbhavanaṁ gacchn dadarśa pavanātmajaḥ ।vividhākṛtirūpāṇi bhavanāni tatastataḥ ॥5-4-9॥

translations.english: Going from one building to another, Hanuman saw mansions of different kinds structures.
